pages.text: Push selected entities using either a uniform direction or a direction relative to the spell center.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: 500*v+500*v*v per target, for push speed v.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.1, regardless of damage, effect level or number of targets.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).

pages.title: Using This Node
pages.text: You do not need to attach any more nodes here. Insert it, then select it to adjust its settings on the right. Right-click it on the canvas to take it back.
